Monica,

Quick finance note: our corporate card provider will generate a virtual card (VCC) for vendor pre-payments but VCCs frequently fail at physical check-in because hotels expect a swipe or imprint for incidentals. If Novaria will be invoiced we should request an AP invoice and push payment terms (Net 30) and a remittance contact. If Redwood is covering any rooms via corpcard, please confirm: (a) which card (we only have two active program cards for events), (b) whether you intend to provide the card at check-in, and (c) whether the hotel accepts pre-authorization holds on a VCC.

If the hotel requires a physical card and Novaria won't provide a guarantee, we can either wire for the room block (preferred) or reimburse any out-of-pocket charges for your team. For reimbursement: keep receipts and use the travel expense form; we can fast-track under "onsite workshop exception" if this is due to a merchant policy mismatch.

-Nikhil

Nikhil / Lauren,

Thanks — quick context so you know why I'm asking: At a customer offsite in May our program card received a pre-auth decline at check-in; the front desk would not accept our virtual guarantee and required a personal card to cover incidentals (our colleague used a personal card and was later reimbursed). I don't want a repeat for Novaria attendees. Novaria Procurement prefers to be invoiced.

Proposal (two options):
1) Novaria sends PO + AP contact and we route invoice to their AP (hotel invoices Novaria). We confirm that Redwood will not be on the hook.
2) If Novaria cannot invoice, Redwood will sign the hotel guarantee and prepay the room block via wire. Nikhil, I need manager approval to prepay/pay via the corporate events card if Novaria asks us to guarantee the block. This would be a one-off exception for a customer-facing enterprise workshop.

Can Lauren please confirm whether we have approval to prepay the block (up to $18,000 USD) if Novaria requests a guarantee? If approved, I'll complete the hotel's guarantee template and route payment to Finance.

Thanks — Monica
